messages:
Mia Chen: FYI heading into Orchard renewal — procurement asked about a training credit instead of a seat discount. Customer worried about time to launch.
AJ Patel: Got it. What's their target launch date?
Mia Chen: July 15. Onboard is behind because SSO integration stalled. CSM says 60% of seats are active.
Sarah Gomez: Do we have capacity for 2 half-day enablement sessions in June? /cc @Samir
Samir Khatri: Yes, can do 6/20 + 6/27. We'll need a formal SOW amendment for training credit.
Mia Chen: Procurement proposing: 6 months extension + one 8-seat training credit (2 sessions) in lieu of $8k discount. Any objections?
AJ Patel: Finance prefer a term extension with modest net new ARR guarantee. What's the value of the training credit?
Mia Chen: Equivalent list value ~ $12k. They want it off the invoice. They won't accept a separate invoice.
Sarah Gomez: We can commit sessions but need acceptance criteria: completion report + recording. Suggest add milestone: 'training delivered + success checklist' to trigger credit.
Mia Chen: Drafted wording (proposal):
```:
Amendment: Customer receives one training credit for up to 8 seats (two half-day sessions). Credit applied as a non-refundable invoice credit against renewal invoice upon delivery and acceptance of training deliverables.
```
Thoughts?
Samir Khatri: Add 'recording and attendee list' to deliverables. Also need to confirm trainer availability.
AJ Patel: Legal flagged data clause — sessions may include customer data. @legal-bot please confirm standard NDA appendix covers this.
legal-bot: Noted. We need a "Customer Data Use" clause added. I'll drop a one-paragraph addendum. ETA EOD.
Mia Chen: Also product backlog note — customer asked for CSV import for seat mappings. They tied it to renewal. Can product evaluate quick win?
Sarah Gomez: Product can prioritize after L0 scoping. @product-team any bandwidth this sprint for a small import utility?
Samir Khatri: If we get feature in 4 weeks we can justify full renewal. Else they will ask for prorated seat credit.
AJ Patel: I'll run numbers: extension + training credit vs. 3-month prorate. Share by EOD.
Mia Chen: Thanks. I'll hold procurement loop until legal & finance confirm. If all good, I'll send amended renewal doc and request signature. :thumbsup:
